Count the children of each parent in the hierarchy

Source: R/tidyMS_data_setup.R
nr_B_in_A.Rd

The number of distinct `level_b` entries, e.g. peptides, within each `level_a` entry, e.g. protein.

Usage

nr_B_in_A(
  pdata,
  level_a,
  level_b,
  name = paste0("nr_", paste(level_b, collapse = "_"), "_IN_", paste(level_a, collapse =
    "_"))
)

Arguments

pdata

data.frame

level_a

parent key columns

level_b

child key columns

name

name of the count column

Value

data.frame of the `level_a` keys and the count column

See also

Other preprocessing: INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS_BY_FAMILY, apply_to_response_matrix(), filter_proteins_by_peptide_count(), get_robscales(), robust_scale(), scale_with_subset()

Examples

istar <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
head(prolfqua:::nr_B_in_A(istar$data, "protein_Id", "peptide_Id"))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   protein_Id  nr_peptide_Id_IN_protein_Id

#> 1 0EfVhX~0087                           3
